messages:
maria (AE): Olympus procurement sent back their Q&A bundle and a compressed RFP. They want written answers + a 1-week POC window. Can we lock a POC week in April? Also need pricing tiers and the security questionnaire filled. @tom can you confirm capacity and a rough price sketch?

tom (SE): I can do capacity + pricing. Tentative POC week: Apr 21-25. Need to confirm dedicated GPU pool availability for that week. I will pull a 3-tier estimate (dev/pilot/prod) and ping infra for availability.

devan (Solutions): I’ll take the security questionnaire and the technical sections of the RFP. Two potential blockers to flag: HSM requirement (they listed 'HSM-backed key isolation' in Q12) and an ask for FedRAMP-ish controls for data at rest. Can someone confirm our HSM story for Private deployments?

kelsey (CS): Legal/Procurement contact is procurement@olympushealth.com (we got it on the docs). Olympus is EU-only for this engagement (data residency). Recommend Dedicated in eu-west-1 + Private if they insist on on-prem HSM. I can intro legal if you want.

tom (SE): Quick capability snippet for the RFP reply — will expand, but dropping initial table here:

```
Feature | Hosted | Dedicated | Notes
Embeddings | ✓ | ✓ | Hosted latency ~45ms, Dedicated ~25ms
KV cache | ✓ | ✓ | Configurable cache size, default 256MB
HSM | ✗ | ✓ | Private/on-prem option supports HSM (customer-managed keys)
SLA | 99.9% | 99.95% | Dedicated & Private have higher SLOs
```

rfi-bot: Draft RFI bundle saved: https://drive.redwood.internal/rfi/olympus/v0.1.pdf — includes the capability table + placeholder legal answers. Please update before Friday.

maria (AE): Plan: Tom — pricing by EOD Wed; Devan — security Qs & RFP answers by Fri; Kelsey — make the legal intro and confirm EU region ops. I’ll assemble the response package and send to procurement on Monday unless we need earlier. :thumbsup: 

kelsey (CS): FYI I’ll CC engineering ops on the intro so we can fast-track any export control or SLA notes.

maria (AE): Thanks team. If infra says no for Apr21, fallback window Apr28-May2. Will post update here.
